reason: MX Retail treatment underfilled because provider-query bounds, transient circuit lifetime and exhaustion semantics did not match the intended resilient search workflow.
rootCauses: Two Brave requests contained 824 and 834 characters after exclusions, exceeding the provider's 600-character limit.
Two SearchAPI requests timed out after two attempts and opened a provider circuit that persisted across discovery rounds.
Rounds with partial provider unavailability were counted toward the two-round confirmed-exhaustion threshold.

changes: Cap complete Brave/SearchAPI queries at 580 characters.
Limit transient provider circuits to one discovery invocation and probe recovery in the next round.
Exclude partially unavailable rounds from confirmed-exhaustion counting.
